Vision Government Solutions

|

SPRAGUE, CT

|

Welcome

Welcome to the Sprague
CT Online Assessment Database.

This site contains the
proposed assessments for the Town of Sprague, CT. The Town has just
completed its state-mandated reassessment. This project was the joint
effort of the Assessor's Office and Vision Government Solutions Inc.

The proposed assessments
reflect 70% of market value as of 10/01/2022. The reappraisal was based
on sales that occurred during the twelve month period between 10/01/2021 and
10/01/2022. Using the sales search tab, users can look up sale data in
order to better understand market trends in Sprague over the past year.

Anyone wishing to
review their assessment with a Vision employee should follow the instructions
on their impact notice, which will be mailed on or about 11/21/2022. Informal
revaluation reviews are being done at pre-scheduled times.

We would like to thank
the residents of Sprague for their cooperation during this project

Contact information for Sprague Assessor’s
office:

Phone: 860-822-3000 ext. 222

Email: spragueassessor@ctsprague.org

You may be prompted to install Silverlight (a free product from Microsoft) after you enter. Follow all the prompts to run the plug-in installer. In some cases, you may need to refresh or restart your browser. If you have any questions please call Vision customer support at 800-628-1013 x2.
